# Chapter Seven: Hunting Prey

The sun was just coming up over the lush trees as Lord Seer Juric Rogan stood there stalwart on the balcony of Seer’s keep, watching as the line of commoners left the village below a straight line as they were escorted to the farms and property, all of which now belonged to the Empress to work them and ensure a good harvest he thought smiling. The houses on the farms had been occupied by guard’s to ensure that no one stole food in the night and the commoners, well those that had not been sent to the capital as either servants or soldiers slept in the old Messengers Keep, spread across the floor they were kept there until it was time to work. The market shops and stores had all been taken over by the soldiers or used as storage to hold goods until they were shipped back to the Empress for use by the army.

No one owned property, shops or well anything he thought, everyone had one purpose in life and that was to serve the Empress by the sweat of there brow. Smiling he thought he could see the royal families somewhere in those lines, like the commoners heading out to the fields to begin the workday. “Lord Rogan” Loric called from the door breaking the Lord Seer from his thoughts. “Yes Loric, what is it” he said turning to regard his assistant.

He crossed the room to come stand next to his Lord as he held out a parchment for his review. Taking it Rogan looked it over, he had always had Loric to do paperwork, even has chancellor Shooting an annoyed look at the young man “What is it Loric?” he asked his tone annoyed and from the look on his assistants face, that was something he didn’t want to see. “My Lord, these are the latest numbers from the fields, we are down this month by twelve percent” he stated, and Rogan frowned. “Loric, we can’t have that the supplies must flow, tell the sergeant at each of the fields, to choose two prisoners, beat them, but not to death this time, just enough to let everyone know I am displeased” he said smiling Loric bowed but still didn’t look happy. “What Loric, we aren’t killing them” he said again a bit annoyed, it was hard to please his assistant he thought, the young man had too much conscious despite what they were striving for.

He stood there watching the young man leave the room, going to give the orders to the sergeants, maybe I will go down and watch Rogan thought smiling. He had never understood true power until the Empress had made him one of her chosen, he now understood that the only way to guide humanity was put a yoke on it and whip it towards your goal he thought, smiling at his clever analogy as Captain Postric entered the room. “Captain, we announce ourselves before entering” Rogan said leveling a hostile gaze at the captain, he couldn’t’ afford to allow even his best servants to lapse he thought, but before he could devise a suitable punishment Postric handed him a parchment, bowing low to his lord. “My Lord, this just came by messenger, your prize is at the Order” he stated, and Rogan was quiet for a moment.

The Empress’s prize had been found he thought a smile spreading across his face. “Very good Postric, I need a small contingent of soldiers, we need to leave right away. Is the messenger still here, I must get a note to the Empress immediately” he finished and Postric nodded, turning on his heels and rushing out of the room to catch the messenger.

Of course, he Lord Rogan would be the one to find and retrieve the Empress’s prize he thought, he had known it was his destiny since the day the Empress had the others cut into him, increasing his power with the runes that now adorned his body. Rogan grinned maliciously as he thought of finally catching the man who would become the centerpiece of the Empress’s army, her general. She of course wouldn’t need to ask him, she had ways of ensuring fealty he thought, rubbing the back of his neck where a small crystal protruded. He frantically wrote a letter, explaining to her what he had found out and his current mission, ending the letter telling her he would enter the palace victorious, her prize trussed on a horse like a prize stag, though alive and well. Sealing the letter, he rushed to the door to find Postric just coming in. “Get this to the Empress immediately” he said shoving it into his hand and turning. It was time to prepare to meet this Marcus he thought.

It was only hours later when Rogan rode out leading a precession of Soldiers. Closing his eyes, he called to his Screamers and a moment later smiled as he gave them orders to shadow the group, he would need them should this Marcus prove as powerful as he was rumored to be he thought.

They rode past the gallows setup just outside the small village where the infirm and elderly swung from ropes, no longer able to work the fields or serve the keep, they were disposed of, examples of what happened when your work slowed he thought smiling up at the line of bodies swinging slowly in the breeze.

He watched a pair of black ravens fighting over the eyes of one small boy who’s broken leg had gotten infected, forcing him to lose it. Of course, as soon as that happened, he was no longer useful, and Rogan could still see the bloody bandage that hung on the nub where the leg had been. The doctor had wanted him to heal before swinging and Rogan laughed at the ludicrousness of the request. Shaking his head, he pushed the horse faster as they rode south past the small village, what once was a testament to the peace and prosperity of the land how stood as a monument to slavery and subjugation, the buildings no longer inhabited and the place once used to foster hope and pray to the emissary was now nothing more then slave quarters.

Things were going well he thought, the chosen had taken their positions as the Lord Seer’s of the territory, there had been no major resistance and any that had formed were quickly put down. The only people who could possibly stand against them he was now on his way to take care of. The Empress’s vision for Vicor and moreso the entire continent was coming together nicely he thought. Postric came to ride next to him, the man ensuring the Lord Seer had protection as with a motion of his hands sent soldiers to ride in guard of him. Rogan smiled at the thought of it, if anything he was the only person in this formation who didn’t require protection he thought, closing his eyes he reached out sensing the Screamers as they shadowed the group. Smiling he opened his eyes and heard the gasp from Postic, it was an odd sensation looking through the eyes of another being and to postic it looked as if Rogan’s entire eye was white.

He saw the brush as the creatures ran through the woods, moving at speeds that most people would find incredible he thought. Then he saw as the creature rose its head and looked out onto the path, looking as the group of them approached. It was almost surreal to see himself riding the horse, the eyes of the Screamers were so incredible he could make out in detail the shocked look on Postric’s face as well as his own ghostly visage as he sat their eyes open, smiling. Both of his eyes white as his vision was elsewhere. Pulling back, his eyes returned to normal and he turned to look at Postric, whos own eyes were still as wide as saucers, even though the man had seen him use his power, he was not used to seeing she of the results of it he thought. “What is it captain” Rogan asked, allowing the annoyance at being gawked at. Postic looked down nodding “Yes sir, I apologize I just wanted to know what our destination was, I know you received a missive but except for scraming to put together the security procession, there was no information on our final location” Postric said. Rogan nodded he had forgotten that, they would need to know of course he thought. “We are going to the order Captain, it is time for them to answer for harboring a fugitive that the Empress seeks, we will meet more of the Empress’s guard on the way and once there, we will be disbanding the Order of the Dragon, the mages will be taken into custody and delivered to the tower, that is all you need to know” he finished and Postic nodded, moving away to brief his commanders.

They rode for two days, only stopping to rest once as they approached the southern territories both Rogan and Postric spotted the guard contingent as they stood on the side of the road awaiting the Lord Seer. Rogan was excited, he wanted to push faster as they were only hours from the Order. If there was still a chance Marcus was there, he would personally ride him to the Capital, he dreamed of the adulation and respect the Empress would shower on him for such a gift and shifted uncomfortably in his saddle.

He had never loved another woman like he had his mistress, he loved her, everything about her and until he had been reborn, made into the being he was now, he had avoided telling himself, afraid of rejection, not able to bring himself to be honest with himself, but now he was one of the most powerful creatures on the face of the planet, he was one of the Chosen a Lord Seer of the Empress’s new regime. He was now someone she could love, someone who could sit upon the throne as her partner. This was his destiny, he felt it, knew it in his bones and one day it would happen, but until then he would ensure that of the chosen, he was the best of them.

A lone figure broke from the large group of soldiers, quickly riding to the small group as they approached. Rogan watched as postric tensed, the soldiers surrounding him closing in and again he smiled. They were loyal and protective, but unnessescary he thought, moving forward and pushing through the soldier’s protective circle. He ignored postric’s protests as he rode out to meet the figure as he approached. Rogan looked over the officer, his uniform pristine with a glowing row of silver and gold metals across his chest as he approached.

“My Lord I am Major Chismer, the Empress assigned myself and my detail to join your mission to secure the Mages” he said, his words crisp and to the point. Rogan nodded in approval “Very good Major, get with Captain Postric and work out the specifics of deploying the men, I don’t want to hesitate when we reach the Order, I would prefer to hit it immediately” he said and before the Major could protest or offer any advice, Rogan rode back to his soldiers. Leaving the Major sitting there, mouth open as whatever protest he had been about to offer died on his lips. Rogan remained aloof as the officers decided on the plan.

He was above such things, there was no one within the halls of the Order who could challenge him, had there been his Screamers were there to ensure that they did not have the chance.

The sun had crested past mid-day and evening was fast approaching as the group finally came to the doors of the Mages order. “Knock for us won’t you Captain” Rogan said, getting off the horse, reaching out he found his screamers and issued the orders that would bring them closer should anything occur. Postric slammed his fist against the large door and the group waited. Soldiers spread out along the front and sides of the building, no one would escape, no one would offer resistance and Rogan waited impatiently, he could sense the Mages, they were in there agitated and scared and this brought a smile to his face as he inhaled the fear and doubt that permeated the air around him. Nodding to the captain he slammed his fist a second time against the aged wood and soon after the doors slid open, standing there resplendent in his robes of office stood Lord Aster, head of the Order of the Dragon.

Rogan had met this man once before and knew that the Empress had been dealing with him for some time. “Please come in” he said eyeing the soldiers nervously as he made way for Rogan. “Keep the soldiers on the building, I will enter along” Rogan whispered to Postric who looked as if he was going to protest, but the look on Rogan’s face told him he was perilously close to danger. So, he closed his mouth and simply nodded as Rogan entered the building.

The small group that stood near the entrance, young and old alike reeked of fear and doubt as Aster quietly spoke to them, calming their fears causing Rogan to suppress a smile. “Where is he Aster” he finally asked, annoyed with the man making him wait. “All in good time.” He began but Rogan with a motion of his hand levitated him, closing his airway and as the Lord of the Mages floated there helpless gagging he stared at the group. “go crawl into your holes, I will deal with you when I am done” he said then turned back to Aster dropping him on the ground unceremoniously “I am tired of games Aster, I am tired of listening to people like you spin your sentences and words as they play there power games, so I will ask again, and you will want to answer me forthwith, where is Marcus Gavin” he stated, staring down at the crumpled form of Aster as he fought air into his lungs.

“He is not here, he escaped” Aster whispered through his raw throat Rogan looked at him, not believing what he was hearing, was it possible, did this man let him go “What?” he said taking a step towards the man “What did you just say?” he pushed, Aster made a feeble attempt to crawl away but Rogan pulled him back to his feet, holding him there he stepped up to the pathetic man “What did you say?” he asked again and he could see the fear in his eyes “He is gone, he escaped, I know he went north, I don’t know where, please, I beg you.” He began, Rogan closed his fist, Aster began screaming as his head collapsed like a watermelon spilling brain and blood over the clean stone floor. “WHAT” he screamed at the body “HOW COULD YOU” he finished, turning his rage on the small group of mages, the screams a salve to the anger he now felt.

Opening the door, he let the soldiers in “Take them all, secure them and prepare them for transport” he said walking out the door as the platoon of soldiers streamed by and quickly began herding the mages into one area. Rogan stood outside looking into the distance, somewhere out there he thought was his prize, as he stood there the man was getting further and further away, heading north. Where would he go Rogan wondered, where would he consider safe and then he knew, knew the only place anyone would consider safe during these times of change, the Mage was heading for the Barrens, heading for the outcasts. The reports had come in the Wardens now resided within the city of the outcasts, that they would assist in defending the territory in order to keep the Empress out of it. In fact, the only reason she had not invaded as of yet, was her plans to attack Dever and Lusor took priority.

Rogan could contact the Empress, could tell her where Marcus was going, she would divert the resources necessary to take the area if it meant attaining him. But he wanted the credit, wanted to be the one to bring him in and that meant, keeping it off of the radar he thought. “Captain” Rogan called and after a few moments postric came to the door “Once you have everyone, take them to the tower and intern them there, I will be leaving” he stated and postric again began to protest, but Rogan shot him another look, would this man never learn he thought looking him over and waiting for him to finish that sentence, Rogan would of course kill him, you could only overlook this kind of thing so many times he thought. But postric closed his mouth and nodded. Apparetnly the man has a healthy survival instince Rogan thought.

He rode out within the hour, looking over his shoulder he saw the line of mages, chained together with chains that could not be manipulated with power, each set made specifically to bind those with the gift. They shuffled forward as more mages were added to the line of prisoners. He could see the hopelessness in their eyes, the few who had resisted the troops had learned very quickly that their armor and weapons were spelled to ensure that no mage could affect or manipulate them, and they died for that discovery. After that it seemed to be smooth sailing Rogan thought with a smile.

Urging the horse, he galloped out of the keep’s main courtyard and barreled down the worn path leading North, towards Marcus.
